relations.text: MKSはAtotech買収の完了に伴い、JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.が管理代理人兼担保代理人を務めるクレジット契約(2022年8月17日付)を結んだ
relations.text_en: In connection with the Atotech Acquisition, MKS entered into a credit agreement dated August 17, 2022 with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent and collateral agent

source.label: MKS Inc. 10-K
source.quote: In connection with the completion of the Atotech Acquisition, on August 17, 2022 (the “Effective Date”) the Company entered into a credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent and collateral agent, Barclays Bank PLC, and the lenders from time to time party thereto (the “Credit Agreement”).
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: 同クレジット契約の第4次修正(2024年7月23日付)がある

relations.text: MKSは、Ophir Optics事業を現金6億5,000万ドルでTTM Technologiesに売却する最終契約を結んだと発表した
relations.text_en: MKS announced a definitive agreement to sell its Ophir Optics business to TTM Technologies in an all-cash transaction for $650 million

source.label: MKS の発表
source.quote: MKS Inc. (NASDAQ: MKSI), a global provider of enabling technologies that transform our world, today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to sell its Ophir® Optics business to TTM Technologies, Inc. (“TTM”) in an all-cash transaction for $650 million, subject to customary closing adjustments.
source.note: 発表された契約で、取引の完了は確認していません。

source.quote: In addition, MKS Instruments, Inc., ( Andover, Mass. ) received special recognition for its support and important contributions to integration goals during the Lam-Novellus merger.
